name: autoUpdateSignaturesEnabled
definition: The Applications-and-Threats content has a recurring update schedule whose action is download-and-install. Download-only is False: the content is fetched but never activated.
population: the update schedule of the one firewall the credential reaches
evidenceRequiredForTrue: The update schedule showing a recurring Applications-and-Threats schedule whose action is download-and-install; an update-schedule that shows no threats element is Not evaluated, never False.
citations: PAN-OS 11.1 XML API and configure CLI command hierarchy (docs.paloaltonetworks.com/pan-os/11-1/pan-os-panorama-api)

changeLog.change: Registered with its first implementation (synthetic-fixture tests only; no real device body replayed yet, so V0).

notes: update-schedule/threats/recurring/<hourly|daily|weekly|every-30-mins>/action (download-only or download-and-install) from the CLI hierarchy; the exact XML spelling of 'none' is UNVERIFIED. An update-schedule with no threats element is Not evaluated, never False: the element name is unverified and schedules pushed by Panorama templates appear here only if the running configuration holds them. False needs a stated finding (recurrence none, or download-only).
